source.locator: Section 2.1 on PDF p.4 freezes the two-fanin depth/count model; Appendix C, Listing 3 on PDF p.34 is the published depth-12 ancestor. The direct same-model predecessor is. The depth-10 disjoint-cover construction is original work.

gate_model.constants: 0 and 1 are depth-zero wires; a tied constant input still counts as a gate
gate_model.depth: inputs and constants have depth 0; every counted gate adds 1 to the maximum input depth
gate_model.nonlinear_depth: NAND2 and NOR2 are counted nonlinear layers; XOR2 and XNOR2 are linear

construction.method: deterministic disjoint one-set cube covers, globally shared balanced conjunction rails, and arrival-aware XOR reductions
construction.cover_selection: in the frozen output order, choose the largest cube contained in the remaining one-set; break ties by the fewest new shared conjunction gates, then fewer literals, smaller mask, and smaller value
construction.search: complete cube enumeration followed by sharing-aware greedy partition; 252 deterministic output orders sampled

not_verified: minimum possible AES S-box depth in this basis
minimum disjoint-cube cover or minimum shared conjunction DAG
